Flat Roof Installation San Francisco | ROOF EXPRESSProfessional Flat Roofing Systems in San Francisco, CA
If you're searching for flat roof installation in San Francisco, you need a roofing system built for fog, moisture, wind, and coastal exposure. At ROOF EXPRESS, we specialize in installing high-performance flat roofing systems designed to protect residential and commercial properties across San Francisco.

As a Diamond Certified roofing company and GAF Certified Installer, we deliver durable, energy-efficient, and leak-resistant flat roofs using proven materials like TPO and modified bitumen.
Why Flat Roofing is Ideal in San Francisco
Flat roofs are extremely common throughout San Francisco due to architectural design and space efficiency. They offer:

Perfect compatibility with modern and multi-unit buildings

Usable space for rooftop decks and solar systems

Lower installation costs compared to pitched roofs

Easier access for maintenance and inspections

Clean, minimalist appearance

However, due to San Francisco’s climate, proper installation is critical to prevent water intrusion and long-term damage.
Best Flat Roofing Systems for San Francisco Homes
At ROOF EXPRESS, we install roofing systems specifically designed for the Bay Area:
TPO Roofing (Thermoplastic Polyolefin)

Highly reflective and energy-efficient (cool roof compliant)

Resistant to UV rays, chemicals, and punctures

Ideal for both homes and commercial buildings

Modified Bitumen (Torch-Down Roofing)

Excellent waterproofing performance in foggy climates

Multi-layer protection for durability

One of the most reliable systems in San Francisco

Built-Up Roofing (BUR)

Traditional multi-layer system

Superior resistance to leaks

Ideal for larger or older buildings

We guide you in selecting the best system based on your building type, budget, and exposure.
Our Flat Roof Installation Process
We follow a strict, professional process to ensure long-term performance:
1. Roof Inspection & Planning
We assess your existing structure, drainage system, and ventilation.
2. Tear-Off & Surface Preparation
Old materials are removed and the roof deck is prepared for installation.
3. Waterproofing System
We install high-quality underlayment and moisture barriers to prevent leaks.
4. Roofing Installation
Your selected system (TPO, torch-down, or BUR) is installed with precision and proper slope design.
5. Final Inspection & Cleanup
We perform a full quality check and leave your property clean and secure.
Common Flat Roof Issues in San Francisco
Due to the coastal climate, flat roofs often face:

Ponding water from improper drainage

Leaks caused by constant moisture exposure

UV damage over time

Cracking or membrane failure

Proper installation and regular maintenance can eliminate these problems.
Why Choose ROOF EXPRESS for Flat Roofing
Homeowners and property managers choose ROOF EXPRESS because we provide:

Diamond Certified quality and proven customer satisfaction

GAF Certified installation standards

Deep expertise in San Francisco roofing systems

Transparent pricing and detailed estimates

Fast project timelines and clean job sites

We don’t just install roofs—we build long-term protection tailored to San Francisco conditions.
